title: Addressing the Session coordinator
description: How to write for a reader acting as Session coordinator. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `session-coordinator` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Situational
rules.description: Situational. State what is in flight, what this session is taking, and what it is explicitly not.

source.quote: Arrives with no memory of the last session and siblings working in parallel. Knows that a claim announces rather than reserves, and that another branch may already be doing this.
